record.bible_text: Now there was a man<WH0376> of Benjamin<WH01144>, whose name<WH08034> <FI>was<Fi> Kish<WH07027>, the son<WH01121> of Abiel<WH022>, the son<WH01121> of Zeror<WH06872>, the son<WH01121> of Bechorath<WH01064>, the son<WH01121> of Aphiah<WH0647>, a Benjamite<WH01145>, a mighty<WH01368> man<WH0376> of power<WH02428>. <RF>a Benjamite: or, the son of a man of Jemini<Rf> <RF>power: or, substance<Rf>

<FI> And<Fi> when they were come<WH0935><WTH8804> to the land<WH0776> of Zuph<WH06689>, Saul<WH07586> said<WH0559><WTH8804> to his servant<WH05288> that <FI>was<Fi> with him, Come<WH03212><WTH8798>, and let us return<WH07725><WTH8799>; lest my father<WH01> leave<WH02308><WTH8799> <FI>caring<Fi> for the asses<WH0860>, and take thought<WH01672><WTH8804> for us.

And he said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Behold now, <FI>there is<Fi> in this city<WH05892> a man<WH0376> of God<WH0430>, and <FI>he is<Fi> an honourable<WH03513><WTH8737> man<WH0376>; all that he saith<WH01696><WTH8762> cometh<WH0935><WTH8799> surely to pass<WH0935><WTH8800>: now let us go<WH03212><WTH8799> thither; peradventure he can shew<WH05046><WTH8686> us our way<WH01870> that we should go<WH01980><WTH8804>.

Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> Saul<WH07586> to his servant<WH05288>, But, behold, <FI>if<Fi> we go<WH03212><WTH8799>, what shall we bring<WH0935><WTH8686> the man<WH0376>? for the bread<WH03899> is spent<WH0235><WTH8804> in our vessels<WH03627>, and <FI> there is<Fi> not a present<WH08670> to bring<WH0935><WTH8687> to the man<WH0376> of God<WH0430>: what have we? <RF>is spent...: Heb. is gone out of, etc<Rf> <RF>have we: Heb. is with us?<Rf>

And the servant<WH05288> answered<WH06030><WTH8800> Saul<WH07586> again<WH03254><WTH8686>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Behold, I have<WH04672><WTH8738> here at hand<WH03027> the fourth part<WH07253> of a shekel<WH08255> of silver<WH03701>: <FI>that<Fi>  will I give<WH05414><WTH8804> to the man<WH0376> of God<WH0430>, to tell<WH05046><WTH8689> us our way<WH01870>. <RF>I have...: Heb. there is found in my hand<Rf>

<FI> And<Fi> as they went up<WH05927><WTH8802> the hill<WH04608> to the city<WH05892>, they found<WH04672><WTH8804> young maidens<WH05291> going out<WH03318><WTH8802> to draw<WH07579><WTH8800> water<WH04325>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto them, Is<WH03426> the seer<WH07200><WTH8802> here? <RF>the hill...: Heb. in the ascent of the city<Rf>

And they went up<WH05927><WTH8799> into<WH08432> the city<WH05892>: <FI>and<Fi> when they were come<WH0935><WTH8802> into the city<WH05892>, behold, Samuel<WH08050> came out<WH03318><WTH8802> against<WH07125><WTH8800> them, for to go up<WH05927><WTH8800> to the high place<WH01116>.

And when Samuel<WH08050> saw<WH07200><WTH8804> Saul<WH07586>, the LORD<WH03068> said<WH06030><WTH8804> unto him, Behold the man<WH0376> whom I spake<WH0559><WTH8804> to thee of! this same shall reign<WH06113><WTH8799> over my people<WH05971>. <RF>reign over: Heb. restrain in<Rf><CM>

Then Saul<WH07586> drew near<WH05066><WTH8799> to Samuel<WH08050> in<WH08432> the gate<WH08179>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Tell<WH05046><WTH8685> me, I pray thee, where<WH0335> the seer's<WH07200><WTH8802> house<WH01004> <FI>is<Fi> .

And as for thine asses<WH0860> that were lost<WH06><WTH8802> three<WH07969> days<WH03117> ago<WH03117>, set<WH07760><WTH8799> not thy mind<WH03820> on them; for they are found<WH04672><WTH8738>. And Saul<WH07586> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, <FI>Am<Fi> not I a Benjamite<WH01145>, of the smallest<WH06996> of the tribes<WH07626> of Israel<WH03478>? and my family<WH04940> the least<WH06810> of all the families<WH04940> of the tribe<WH07626> of Benjamin<WH01144>? wherefore then speakest<WH01696><WTH8765> thou so<WH01697> to me? <RF>so...: Heb. according to this word<Rf>
